I am a certified and licensed massage therapist in multiple states. I also provide live ASMR massage experiences. You can find a link to my website if you would like to book a massage therapy session. At this location, you can book a Therapeutic massage or Ashiatsu massage for 60, 90, and 120 minutes. ASMR massages are for established clients only at this time.
